claims.text: Many reviewers report their stretch marks fading, lightening, or becoming less visible after using the cream.
Reviewers frequently praise the cream's pleasant smell and smooth, non-sticky texture.
Several users note the product works well and is a good value for the cost.
Some reviewers mention the bottle is small or wish it were larger.
A few reviewers say it is too early to fully judge results since they have only used it briefly.
